lift-it.netlist:
* Flux Garden: DC motor lifting a rigid rack load, generated from a validated description
Vdd nd 0 DC 6
Vsw ctl 0 PWL(0 0 0.02 0 0.021 1 0.6 1)
S1 nd na ctl 0 SWMAIN
.model SWMAIN SW(RON=0.05 ROFF=1000000000 VT=0.5 VH=0.1)
RM na nb 2
LM nb nc 0.005
EB nc 0 vw 0 0.3
Vdp 0 dk DC 0
D1 dk na DFW
.model DFW D(IS=1e-14 N=1 RS=0.1 CJO=0 TT=0 BV=75 IBV=0.00001)
Bt 0 vw I=0.3*i(LM)
Cj vw 0 0.00066
Rb vw 0 1000
Il vw 0 DC 0.0392266
Vbrk brk 0 PWL(0 1 0.02 1 0.021 0 0.6 0)
Vbr vw bk DC 0
Sb bk 0 brk 0 SWBRAKE
.model SWBRAKE SW(RON=1e-6 ROFF=1e12 VT=0.5 VH=0.1)
.options reltol=1e-4
.tran 0.0001 0.6 0 0.0001
.end
